title: The World of Wraeclast & Its Peoples
subtitle: Cultures, history, and wisdom of the races

cards.title: Azmeri — Mountain Folk & Draíocht
cards.text: The oldest surviving civilization. Lord's Trial — a test for choosing leaders through strength, wit, and spirit. Worship Draíocht — the Triple Goddess (Mhacha — nature, Catha — good/evil, Mórrigan — courage). Maji serve as Azmeri priests.
cards.flavorText: "Do not disturb the earth, it keeps secrets better when no one knows." — Azmeri proverb

cards.title: Maraketh — Desert Warrior Women
cards.text: A matriarchal society — Sekhema is the leader. Tale-women — storytellers, keepers of history, some skilled in chronomancy (time magic). Djinn system — criminals have their souls extracted and imprisoned in barya. "Honour the Mother, Honour Life" — their most sacred tenet.
cards.flavorText: "Kings will fall, empires will crumble, mortals will die. All becomes dust and sand." — Maraketh proverb

cards.title: Karui — Warriors & Makanui (The Way)
cards.text: Ngakuramakoi — no Karui blood required, only The Way. Coming-of-age trial: climb the Isle of Shrikes to retrieve an egg. Principle: "Protect the land, it nourishes us. Go forward, the next tribe finds it whole." Gems forbidden. Tattoos = achievements.
cards.flavorText: "Karui women do not belong on the battlefield, but at the hearth fire. Hyrri changed everything." — Hyrri's Demise

cards.title: Ezomyte — Runes & Song
cards.text: History kept through song, not written records. Runes were brought by "strangers" — "There was a great storm, a great need, lest the soaked ones die." Agnar — ancient rune-sword of the clan chief. Druids — Cirel of Tarth welcomed the first settlers, grew the fortress Taisce.
cards.flavorText: "The stone is not a stone, it is merely part of a fortress." — Ezomyte proverb

cards.title: Vaal — Architects & Sacrifice
cards.text: Born from Xibaqua. "Proud of every temple, seeing each shrine as proof of gods... then of themselves." Master-slave relations were "intimate and volatile as lovers." They worshipped peace but none dared provoke them.
cards.flavorText: "Though the Vaal worshipped peace, any culture that provoked them was clearly suicidal." — Icius Perandus
